item.title: Capability-based event labels now replace webinar and town hall names across Teams guides — 7 November 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 7 November 2026

Capability-based event labels now replace webinar and town hall names across Teams guides

The period is dominated by a coordinated terminology pass across event administration. Microsoft Learn now uses “Events up to 1k attendees” and “Events optimized for a large audience” in policy references and event guides, while individual pages rename anonymous-attendance, transcription, and event-chat controls. The recording guidance also distinguishes events with up to 1,000 attendees from large-audience events and clarifies policy assignment.

Teams · Policies and settings

Policy references adopt audience-size labels

The Settings Policies Reference replaces webinar and town hall terminology with the exact labels “Events up to 1k attendees” and “Events optimized for a large audience” across related settings.

Meetings and events · General

Recording guidance separates event audience sizes

The Meeting Recording article now groups webinars and town halls under events, documents recording settings for events with up to 1,000 attendees or for large audiences, and clarifies policy-assignment instructions.

Meetings and events · General

Anonymous-attendance steps use the new event labels

The Anonymous Users In Meetings guide now refers to “Who can attend events up to 1k attendees” and “Who can attend events optimized for a large audience,” with corresponding updated configuration steps.

Meetings and events · General

Caption controls retain defaults under renamed toggles

Meeting Transcription Captions replaces the webinar and town hall toggle names with attendee-based labels and clarifies policy-assignment steps. Both settings remain On by default.

Meetings and events · General

Event chat receives an audience-based setting name

The dropdown label “Town hall chat experience” is now “Events optimized for a large audience chat experience.” Its options remain Optimized (default) and None.

View all updates for 7 November 2026 →

item.title: Teams Rooms app update tool is no longer recommended for new Autopilot deployments — 6 November 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 6 November 2026

Teams Rooms app update tool is no longer recommended for new Autopilot deployments

This was a quiet, documentation-led day with one actionable Teams Rooms change. The Autopilot guidance says the Teams Rooms app has included automatic updates since April 2024, so the app update tool is no longer recommended for new deployments. A separate known-issues entry records possible Large Gallery unavailability on specified Teams Rooms for Android versions, while release notes document a low-bitrate video fix. Teams Phone updates only reorder language entries in reference and setup material.

Teams Rooms · General

Autopilot guidance changes the app update tool recommendation

Because the Teams Rooms app has included automatic updates since April 2024, the app update tool is no longer recommended for new deployments. Administrators should review Intune configurations and consider unassigning the tool, except when deploying devices older than 2025.

Devices · Troubleshooting

Large Gallery may be unavailable on specified Teams Rooms for Android versions

The known-issues page identifies possible Large Gallery unavailability on Teams Rooms for Android app versions 1449/1.0.96.2026249711 through 1449/1.0.96.2026264504. The issue is expected to be addressed in a future update, and no administrator action is specified.

Teams Rooms · General

Release notes record a low-bitrate video fix

Teams Rooms release notes now document a fix for certain devices sending low-bitrate video in specific meeting scenarios. The supplied evidence states no administrator action.

View all updates for 6 November 2026 →

item.title: Teams will organize muted and meeting chats into dedicated sections in January — 5 November 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 5 November 2026

Teams will organize muted and meeting chats into dedicated sections in January

Microsoft Teams will introduce a January 2027 chat reorganization: the Muted chats section will be enabled by default, while Meeting chats will be disabled by default, with users able to toggle and reorder both. Two worldwide changes are also planned for December 2026: a Workflows template that links team tags to channel membership and mobile call declines with chat messages. Documentation updates add certified-device entries and SlimCore troubleshooting detail.

Teams · General

Muted and meeting chats get dedicated sections in January 2027

Teams will add Muted chats and Meeting chats sections. Muted chats will be enabled by default, while Meeting chats will be disabled by default. Users can enable or disable and reorder the sections, and muted chats move automatically unless they are favorited. Rollout begins in January 2027, with no admin action required.

Teams · General

Workflows will connect team tags to channel membership

An optional Workflows app template will automatically add users to channels when they are added to a team tag. The feature rolls out worldwide in mid-December 2026 and does not change defaults.

Teams · General

Teams mobile users will be able to decline calls with messages

Users will be able to decline incoming Teams mobile calls with a predefined or custom message sent through Teams chat. Worldwide rollout is scheduled for December 2026; the feature applies only to Teams-to-Teams calls with available chat and requires no admin action.

Devices · General

Certified Hardware Android adds Meeting Owl and Cisco entries

The table now includes Meeting Owl 5 Pro, Owl Tablet, and multiple Cisco devices, along with their associated software versions and certification dates. Administrators can use these details when validating inventories and planning deployments.

Clients · Troubleshooting

SlimCore troubleshooting adds Windows error 6/51 guidance

Vdi 2 Troubleshooting now documents Windows error 6/51, ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE, during SlimCore download, deployment, or startup, and points administrators to BITS Client and AppXDeployment-Server logs.

View all updates for 5 November 2026 →
